d: Chandragupt apne aachary vishnugupt ke maun se aahat hai vo unse aagrah karta hai ki vah unhen apni pira bataen. vahin vishnugupt ke aachary bhi unke maun hone ka karan janna chahte hain. parantu vishnugupt maun hain , unke hraday men aakrosh ki jvala dhadhak rahi hai - kya nirnay lenge vishnugupt taki yavnon dvara bharatvarsh men aur adhik pralay karne se rok saken - dekhiye is bhag men.
